text:
emma: FYI — customer (ACME) just upgraded their Dedicated deployment to redwood-py 1.12 and their streaming chat call started returning a list instead of an async iterator. Breaking in prod :grimacing:
rahul: Ack. Do you have the exact call / traceback they saw?
emma: They sent a minimal repro: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=...)
resp = client.chat.stream(model='gpt-test', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'long story please'}])
# used as an async iterator in their codebase
async for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk)
# -> TypeError: 'list' object is not async iterable
```
kevin: That's unexpected. In 1.12 we did some unification work for sync/async streaming but this should preserve iterator semantics. @jen any rollout notes? :eyes:
jen: We merged a change that attempted to collect short streams to reduce small-response overhead. Looks like the gRPC wrapper accidentally returns a collected list in the sync codepath for some cases. I'll investigate.
emma: ACME is pinned to 1.12 in their private env so they can't get a new release without us patching. How urgent is a rollback vs a quick fix?
rahul: Short-term remediation: recommend pinning to 1.11.1 while we patch: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.11.1` or revert their package. If they must stay on 1.12 and need streaming behavior, they can coerce with `iter(resp)` but that will still be memory-y if it's a real list.
kevin: I tried to reproduce locally: with a long stream I get an async generator; with short payloads the wrapper currently does `list(stream)` and returns that. Repro snippet: ```python
# sync client repro
resp = client.chat.stream(...)
print(type(resp))  # list for short responses, <class 'async_generator'> for long ones
```
jen: Confirmed. I'll push a hotfix to restore generator semantics for `chat.stream()` (preserve streaming always) and add an env toggle `REDWOOD_STREAM_COLLECT=true|false` to control collection behavior for edge cases. Rolling patch target: 2 hours.
emma: I'll tell ACME: 1) downgrade to 1.11.1 to restore behavior immediately; 2) if they keep 1.12, set `REDWOOD_STREAM_COLLECT=false` if the env var exists in the next patch; 3) we'll notify when the hotfix is deployed.
rahul: I'll draft a support KB entry / canned response: short description, pip pin instructions, snippet to detect list vs async iterator, and recommended follow-ups.
jen: Opening hotfix PR now, will attach CI run and changelog note.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 (P2) — assigned to @jen.
emma: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket with repro and customer impact. :thumbsup:
